summary: Resolve both smalltalk and fractal Home Manager launchd agent labels so the worker supervisor remains discoverable after the service rename. Prefer running agents, then installed agents, with legacy labels breaking ties.

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: Both Home Manager label families are recognized for the default instance. Named instances and native service conflict checks are unchanged. Worker identity caching and single-flight observation are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Takes effect with the next daemon build.
